$comment: Sample categorisation rules in the v1 CategorizationRule shape (af_core prisma/schema.prisma lines 800–831, commit a2fe220). v1 shipped NO seed rules; the examples below are the ones named in docs/feature-inventory.md §3.10 and docs/excel-to-v3-mapping.md Sheet 1 (OPENAI → OpenAI, MSFT → Microsoft, AVGIFTER NORDEA → bank fees, SALARY / SKATTEVERKET). BAS numbers are the standard kontoplan accounts the owner's aliases point to and MUST be confirmed with the accountant; v3 stores a BAS category id, not a number. `matchField` ∈ name|message|sender|recipient|all; `matchType` ∈ CONTAINS|STARTS_WITH|ENDS_WITH|EXACT|REGEX; priority 0–999, UI-created rules get 100.

v1ShapeExample.name: Nordea banking fees
v1ShapeExample.description: Monthly account fees, grey italic rows in the Excel

rules.name: OpenAI subscription
rules.bas: 6540 IT-tjänster (owner alias Ut — Licences, Cloud and Utilities)

rules.name: Salary
rules.note: yellow rows in the Excel; recurring manual-entry template in v3 (D14 widget uses them)

rules.name: Skatteverket
rules.bas: 2710 / 2731 (tax + social charges — split by the accountant)

rules.name: Savings interest
rules.note: savings account: Name is empty, 'Ränta 2024' sits in Additional details, the year sits in Sender — see v3 __fixtures__/nordea-interest.csv. matchField 'message' here means v2 'details' once v3 maps fields; see harvest §8

matcherSemantics.caseInsensitive: CONTAINS/STARTS_WITH/ENDS_WITH/EXACT lower-case both sides; REGEX runs new RegExp(pattern, 'i') on the ORIGINAL text; an invalid regex never matches
matcherSemantics.fieldAll: name + message + additionalDetails + sender + recipient joined by one space, empty parts dropped
matcherSemantics.emptyText: empty field value never matches (even EXACT '' )
matcherSemantics.conflict: active rules sorted by priority DESC, first match wins; equal priority → undefined order (v1 has no tie-break)

testPatternCases.note: invalid regex → no match, no throw
